description: Modern Xposed Service - Communication interface between Xposed framework and module app (IPC, Scope Management, Process Discovery, Hot Reload, RemotePreferences, and Direct Boot)

directBoot.summary: XposedProvider is Direct Boot aware. Xposed frameworks can deliver service binders before the user unlocks the device for the first time after a reboot.
guidelines: The module app's Application initialization and service listener callbacks must be safe to run before user unlock.
Use Context.createDeviceProtectedStorageContext() for local data needed before unlock.
Defer access to credential-protected storage until UserManager.isUserUnlocked() returns true.
Remote preferences and remote files availability before unlock depends on framework implementation.

constants.name: API_102
constants.doc:
API version 102.

API additions:

  • Running hooked targets can be queried.
  • Hot reload can be requested for a hooked target when permitted by the framework.

constants.name: PROP_CAP_SYSTEM
constants.doc: The framework has the capability to hook system_server and other system processes.

constants.name: PROP_CAP_REMOTE
constants.doc: The framework provides remote preferences and remote files support.

constants.name: PROP_RT_API_PROTECTION
constants.doc: The framework disallows accessing Xposed API via reflection or dynamically loaded code.

methods.name: getRunningTargets
methods.doc:
Get a list of currently running processes that are hooked by the module.

Returned targets can be passed to {@link #hotReloadModule(HookedTarget, Bundle, HotReloadCallback)}. The pid, uid, process name, and loaded version code are diagnostic values only.

@return The list of hooked processes @throws UnsupportedOperationException If the framework does not support service API 102 @throws ServiceException If the service is dead or an error occurred
